# TheSkeletalSystem.net

> > Comprehensive anatomical reference for human skeletal system bones, covering cranial, axial, and appendicular skeleton structures with detailed diagrams and classifications.

TheSkeletalSystem.net provides detailed anatomical information about bones throughout the human body, including the skull, spine (cervical, thoracic, and lumbar vertebrae), upper extremities (humerus, radius, ulna, carpals, metacarpals), and lower extremities (femur, tibia, fibula, tarsals, metatarsals). Each bone entry includes location, structure, ossification, articulations, and labeled anatomical diagrams.

## Skeletal System Fundamentals

- [Types of Bones](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/types-of-bones): 5 bone classifications: long, short, flat, irregular, sesamoid bones
- [Spine (Vertebral Column) – Bones, Anatomy, & Labeled Diagram](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/spine-vertebral-column): Vertebral column structure: cervical, thoracic, lumbar, sacrum, coccyx
- [Lumbar Vertebrae (Lumbar Spine) – Anatomy, Location, & Diagram](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/spine-vertebral-column/lumbar-vertebrae.html): Five lumbar vertebrae (L1-L5) of lower back spine anatomy

## Skull and Cranial Bones

- [Cranial Bones – Names, Anatomy, Location & Labeled Diagram](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/cranial-bones): Neurocranium bones: frontal, occipital, parietal, ethmoid, temporal
- [Palatine Bone – Location, Functions, Anatomy, & Diagram](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/skull-bones/palatine-bone.html): Palatine bone of hard palate, nasal & orbital cavities with processes
- [Vomer – Definition, Location, Functions, Anatomy, & Diagram](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/skull-bones/vomer.html): Vomer facial bone forms nasal septum dividing nasal cavity

## Thoracic Skeleton

- [Bones of the Chest – Names, Basic Anatomy, and Diagram](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/chest-bones): Thorax bones: sternum (manubrium, xiphoid process) & ribs anatomy

## Upper Extremity Bones

- [Carpal Bones (Wrist Bones): Definition, Names, Anatomy, Diagram](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/carpal-bones): Eight carpal wrist bones: scaphoid, lunate, triquetrum, pisiform & more
- [Metacarpals: Definition, Location, Anatomy, Function, Diagram](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/metacarpal-bones): Five metacarpal hand bones: head, base, shaft & carpal articulations
- [Ulna – Definition, Location, Anatomy, Functions, Labeled Diagram](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/arm-bones/ulna.html): Ulna forearm bone: olecranon, coronoid processes & radius articulation
- [Lunate Bone: Definition, Location, Anatomy, Function, Diagram](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/arm-bones/lunate-bone.html): Lunate (semilunar) carpal bone anatomy, ossification & articulations
- [Fourth Metacarpal: Definition, Location, Anatomy, Diagram](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/arm-bones/fourth-metacarpal-bone.html): 4th metacarpal (ring finger) articulates with capitate & hamate bones
- [Middle Phalanx: Definition, Location, Anatomy, Diagram](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/arm-bones/middle-phalanx.html): Middle phalanges of fingers: PIP joints, surfaces & ossification

## Lower Extremity Bones

- [Bones in the Leg - Their Names, Basic Anatomy & Labeled Diagram](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/leg-bone): Lower extremity bones: femur, patella, tibia, fibula, tarsals & more
- [Tibia (Shin Bone): Definition, Location, Anatomy, & Diagrams](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/leg-bone/tibia.html): Tibia shin bone: structure, muscle attachments & femur/talus joints
- [Metatarsal Bones – Definition, Location, Anatomy, & Functions](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/metatarsal-bones): Five metatarsal long bones of forefoot: anatomy, base, head & functions
- [Patella (Kneecap): Definition, Location, Anatomy, & Diagram](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/leg-bone/patella.html): Patella sesamoid bone anatomy: base, apex, facets & knee joint function
- [Cuneiform Bones - Definition, Location, Anatomy, & Diagrams](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/leg-bone/cuneiform-bones.html): Medial, intermediate & lateral cuneiform tarsal bones of midfoot
- [Second Metatarsal Bone Location, Anatomy, & Diagram](https://www.theskeletalsystem.net/leg-bone/second-metatarsal.html): 2nd metatarsal anatomy: head, body, base & tarsometatarsal joints
